decks.notes: This deck focuses on utilizing a variety of creatures with different abilities to assemble powerful combos and answer threats from the opponent. The toolbox approach allows the player to search for specific creatures needed for the situation using cards like Chord of Calling and Summoner's Pact. Cards like Delighted Halfling and Springheart Nantuko provide value and flexibility in different stages of the game. The inclusion of support cards like Shuko and Boseiju, Who Endures helps to protect key pieces and ensure the combo goes off smoothly.

Utilizing a variety of creature toolbox options and combo potential, this deck focuses on tutoring for specific creatures to either control the board or win the game quickly. By using cards like Chord of Calling and Summoner's Pact, the deck can search for key creatures like Endurance or Thassa's Oracle to either disrupt opponents or set up for a win condition. With the ability to tutor for creatures and access to powerful land options like Urza's Saga and Boseiju, Who Endures, this deck aims to outpace and outmaneuver opponents through its versatile creature toolbox.

The deck focuses on utilizing creatures with abilities to create a toolbox of options for various situations. It also includes combo pieces like Chord of Calling and Springheart Nantuko to create powerful synergies. The deck includes cards like Urza's Saga for additional value and consistency. By tutoring for specific creatures or combo pieces using cards like Shuko and Chord of Calling, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents with a versatile array of threats and answers. The inclusion of cards like Misty Rainforest and Windswept Heath allows for consistent mana fixing and ramp.

The deck focuses on ramping up mana quickly through the UrzaTron lands (Urza's Mine, Power Plant, Tower) and using Karn, the Great Creator to control the board by fetching artifacts and shutting down opposing strategies. It also utilizes colorless Eldrazi creatures like Devourer of Destiny and Ulamog, the Ceaseless Hunger to apply pressure and disrupt the opponent's game plan. All Is Dust and Kozilek's Command serve as strong removal options, while World Breaker provides additional utility and disruption. Overall, the deck aims to outvalue and outlast opponents through efficient control and powerful threats.

The main idea of this deck is to control the board using Eldrazi creatures and powerful control spells. The deck focuses on ramping up to play big threats like Emrakul, the World Anew while also disrupting the opponent's game plan with cards like All Is Dust and Kozilek's Command. The deck also utilizes artifacts like The Underworld Cookbook and the Talisman of Unity to help accelerate its game plan. Overall, the deck aims to outvalue and outlast the opponent through a combination of control elements and powerful Eldrazi creatures.

The deck focuses on quickly overwhelming the opponent with aggressive creatures and disruption spells, aiming to maintain control of the battlefield while also draining the opponent's life total. It utilizes a mix of efficient removal spells, hand disruption, and powerful creatures to apply constant pressure and disrupt the opponent's game plan. The deck also includes graveyard recursion and sacrifice effects to generate additional value and maintain its tempo advantage. Overall, the deck aims to close out the game swiftly before the opponent can fully establish their own game plan.

This deck focuses on generating a large amount of mana quickly using rituals and mana-producing cards to cast powerful spells like Past in Flames multiple times in a single turn. The goal is to consistently combo off and deal a massive amount of damage to the opponent in one explosive turn. Ral, Monsoon Mage and Glimpse the Impossible play a key role in drawing through the deck quickly, while Wish provides flexibility in accessing key cards from the sideboard. The deck aims to win the game quickly and efficiently by overwhelming the opponent with its powerful combo.

Utilizing the powerful UrzaTron lands, this deck focuses on controlling the game with cards like Thought-Knot Seer and Karn, the Great Creator. By ramping up mana quickly with Urza's lands and Eldrazi Temple, the deck aims to disrupt opponents' strategies with counter spells like All Is Dust and Kozilek's Command. The win condition comes from the Eldrazi titans Ulamog, the Ceaseless Hunger and Devourer of Destiny, backed up by cards like The One Ring and Ugin's Labyrinth. The deck also includes Boseiju, Who Endures for protection and Talisman of Resilience for additional mana ramp.

This deck focuses on assembling the UrzaTron lands (Urza's Mine, Urza's Tower, Urza's Power Plant) to generate large amounts of mana quickly. Once the Tron is assembled, the deck aims to control the game with powerful Eldrazi creatures like Emrakul and Karn, backed up by disruptive spells like Kozilek's Command and All Is Dust. The use of Ugin, the Spirit Dragon and The One Ring provide additional threats and ways to control the board. The deck's goal is to outvalue opponents with its powerful threats and disruption while overwhelming them with mana advantage.

The deck focuses on assembling a toolbox of creatures that can be searched for and put into play using cards like Chord of Calling and Urza's Saga. By using a combination of mana ramp creatures, protection spells, and disruptive creatures, the deck can quickly assemble a board presence to overwhelm the opponent. The key strategy is to tutor for specific creatures that can disrupt the opponent's game plan or provide a win condition, while also utilizing cards like Malevolent Rumble to control the board and maintain tempo.

This Mardu Aggro deck focuses on a combination of sacrificing creatures for value with cards like Goblin Bombardment and Village Rites, while also using powerful creatures like Amped Raptor and Guide of Souls to apply pressure on the opponent. The deck also includes a variety of versatile removal spells like Fatal Push and Chthonian Nightmare to control the board. With the addition of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion, the deck aims to maintain a steady stream of threats and disruption to overwhelm opponents in a Modern 1 vs 1 match.

This deck focuses on using creatures and various tools to assemble powerful combos quickly. The deck utilizes cards like Misty Rainforest and Wooded Foothills to search for the necessary pieces, while also including creatures like Arboreal Grazer and Springheart Nantuko to provide additional support. Cards like Thassa's Oracle and The One Ring are key to achieving victory, while cards like Chord of Calling help to tutor for specific creatures when needed. Overall, the deck aims to be versatile and adaptable, with the ability to pull off game-winning combos in a variety of ways.

The deck focuses on utilizing cards like Indomitable Creativity, Persist, and Archon of Cruelty to create powerful combo plays that disrupt the opponent's game plan. It also includes cards like Wrenn and Six, Inquisition of Kozilek, and Lightning Bolt for additional control and removal. The deck aims to generate a high level of creativity by using various cards in unique ways to create powerful synergies and win conditions. By combining different pieces together, the deck strives to create unexpected and innovative strategies to outsmart the opponent and secure victory.

The main focus of this Boros Aggro deck is to overwhelm your opponent with fast and aggressive creatures, backed up by powerful burn spells and disruptive enchantments. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion adds an extra layer of consistency to the deck. By curving out efficiently and applying consistent pressure, this deck aims to close out games quickly before the opponent can stabilize. The deck also has some control elements to disrupt the opponent's game plan and give you the edge in combat.

This deck focuses on a fast and aggressive playstyle, utilizing a variety of powerful creatures and spells to quickly overwhelm the opponent. The inclusion of Jegantha as a companion provides additional mana ramp and versatility. The deck also includes key disruptive elements like Static Prison and Chthonian Nightmare to control the board while maintaining pressure. With a mix of efficient creatures like Amped Raptor and powerful planeswalkers like Ajani, Nacatl Pariah, this deck aims to close out games quickly and decisively. With a solid mana base and a mix of removal and threats, it aims to dominate the early game and maintain pressure throughout.

The deck focuses on using creatures with aggressive abilities to quickly apply pressure on the opponent. It includes cards that disrupt the opponents' game plan and control the board, while also featuring powerful creatures like Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury and Ajani, Nacatl Pariah. The deck also utilizes the companion Jegantha, the Wellspring for additional mana ramp. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and aggressive strategy, while also providing some control elements to maintain tempo and advantage throughout the game.
